# Purpose

The upper bound is an independently sampled authentic biomedical corpus. It
therefore provides two complementary calibration checks:

1. against real general-language text, it should recover the authentic
   biomedical divergence profile;
2. against the authentic biomedical reference, it should exhibit little
   residual divergence.

The notebook focuses on the quantities needed to tell that story: feature
recovery, effect and ranking agreement, residual discoveries in the
biomedical--biomedical comparison, sampling stability, cluster recovery, and
the paired RF variation used to diagnose the equivalence margin. The full model
inventory and cross-language meta-cluster analysis remain in the main LLM
notebook.

# Load the three required comparisons

```{r helpers}
read_result <- function(directory, stem, required = TRUE) {
  path <- file.path(directory, paste0(stem, ".rds"))
  if (!file.exists(path)) {
    if (required) stop("Required result is missing: ", path)
    return(tibble())
  }
  as_tibble(readRDS(path))
}

safe_ratio <- function(numerator, denominator) {
  ifelse(denominator > 0, numerator / denominator, NA_real_)
}

safe_f1 <- function(precision, recall) {
  ifelse(
    is.finite(precision) & is.finite(recall) & precision + recall > 0,
    2 * precision * recall / (precision + recall),
    0
  )
}

safe_mean <- function(x) {
  x <- x[is.finite(x)]
  if (length(x) == 0) return(NA_real_)
  mean(x)
}

safe_median <- function(x) {
  x <- x[is.finite(x)]
  if (length(x) == 0) return(NA_real_)
  median(x)
}

safe_max <- function(x) {
  x <- x[is.finite(x)]
  if (length(x) == 0) return(NA_real_)
  max(x)
}

safe_spearman <- function(x, y, min_n = 3L) {
  keep <- is.finite(x) & is.finite(y)
  if (sum(keep) < min_n) return(NA_real_)
  suppressWarnings(cor(x[keep], y[keep], method = "spearman"))
}

safe_quantile <- function(x, probability) {
  x <- x[is.finite(x)]
  if (length(x) == 0) return(NA_real_)
  unname(quantile(x, probability, names = FALSE, type = 8))
}

clean_scores <- function(x, object_name) {
  required <- c(
    "language", "feature", "cohens_d", "delta_z",
    "borda_score", "q_perm"
  )
  require_columns(x, required, object_name)

  x %>%
    transmute(
      language = as.character(language),
      feature = as.character(feature),
      cohens_d,
      delta_z,
      borda_score,
      q_perm
    ) %>%
    distinct(language, feature, .keep_all = TRUE)
}

split_members <- function(x) {
  if (length(x) == 0 || is.na(x) || !nzchar(x)) return(character())
  str_split(as.character(x), ",\\s*")[[1]] %>%
    str_trim() %>%
    discard(~ !nzchar(.x)) %>%
    unique()
}

jaccard <- function(a, b) {
  union_ab <- union(a, b)
  if (length(union_ab) == 0) return(NA_real_)
  length(intersect(a, b)) / length(union_ab)
}
```

```{r load-results}
# Authentic calibration target:
# real general versus the original real biomedical sample.
real_primary <- read_result(real_dir, "per_lang_scores") %>%
  clean_scores("real/per_lang_scores")

# Upper-bound recovery check:
# real general versus an independent real biomedical sample.
upper_primary <- read_result(upper_dir, "per_lang_scores") %>%
  clean_scores("upper_bound/per_lang_scores")

# Upper-bound noise-floor check:
# original real biomedical versus independent real biomedical.
upper_null <- read_result(upper_null_dir, "per_lang_scores") %>%
  clean_scores("upper_bound/real_biomedical_vs_biomedical/per_lang_scores")

input_inventory <- tibble(
  comparison = c(
    "authentic domain contrast",
    "upper-bound domain contrast",
    "upper-bound biomedical--biomedical control"
  ),
  n_languages = c(
    n_distinct(real_primary$language),
    n_distinct(upper_primary$language),
    n_distinct(upper_null$language)

  n_language_features = c(
    nrow(real_primary),
    nrow(upper_primary),
    nrow(upper_null)

```

# 1. Recovery of the authentic feature profile

The primary calibration question is whether the independent authentic
biomedical sample reproduces the significant features, their directions, and
the broader ordering of feature divergence.

```{r feature-profile-agreement}
feature_comparison <- full_join(
  real_primary %>%
    rename_with(
      ~ paste0("real_", .x),
      -c(language, feature)
    ),
  upper_primary %>%
    rename_with(
      ~ paste0("upper_", .x),
      -c(language, feature)
    ),
  by = c("language", "feature")
) %>%
  mutate(
    real_significant =
      is.finite(real_q_perm) & real_q_perm <= alpha,
    upper_significant =
      is.finite(upper_q_perm) & upper_q_perm <= alpha,
    recovered = real_significant & upper_significant,
    direction_agrees = case_when(
      !recovered ~ NA,
      !is.finite(real_delta_z) | !is.finite(upper_delta_z) ~ NA,
      TRUE ~ sign(real_delta_z) == sign(upper_delta_z)
    )
  )

feature_recovery <- feature_comparison %>%
  group_by(language) %>%
  summarise(
    n_common_features = sum(
      is.finite(real_cohens_d) & is.finite(upper_cohens_d)
    ),
    n_authentic_significant = sum(real_significant),
    n_upper_significant = sum(upper_significant),
    n_recovered = sum(recovered),
    recall = safe_ratio(n_recovered, n_authentic_significant),
    precision = safe_ratio(n_recovered, n_upper_significant),
    f1 = safe_f1(precision, recall),
    direction_agreement = safe_mean(direction_agrees[recovered]),
    rho_signed_cohens_d =
      safe_spearman(real_cohens_d, upper_cohens_d),
    rho_borda =
      safe_spearman(real_borda_score, upper_borda_score),
    median_absolute_d_difference =
      safe_median(abs(real_cohens_d - upper_cohens_d)),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(language)

feature_recovery
```

The recovery measures answer distinct questions. Recall measures how much of
the authentic inventory reappears; precision penalizes upper-bound-only
discoveries; direction agreement checks whether recovered features change in
the same direction. Correlations are calculated over all jointly available
features and therefore describe the complete divergence profile rather than
only the significant subset.

# 2. Residual divergence between authentic biomedical samples

The biomedical--biomedical comparison estimates the empirical noise floor.
The important result is not that every feature difference is exactly zero, but
whether adjusted discoveries are rare and effect sizes are small relative to
the authentic domain contrast.

```{r biomedical-control}
null_summary <- upper_null %>%
  group_by(language) %>%
  summarise(
    n_features_tested = n_distinct(feature),
    n_significant = sum(is.finite(q_perm) & q_perm <= alpha),
    prop_significant = n_significant / n_features_tested,
    median_absolute_d = safe_median(abs(cohens_d)),
    q95_absolute_d = safe_quantile(abs(cohens_d), 0.95),
    maximum_absolute_d = safe_max(abs(cohens_d)),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(language)

null_summary
```

```{r contrast-strength-comparison}
contrast_strength <- bind_rows(
  real_primary %>%
    mutate(comparison = "authentic domain contrast"),
  upper_primary %>%
    mutate(comparison = "upper-bound domain contrast"),
  upper_null %>%
    mutate(comparison = "biomedical--biomedical control")
) %>%
  group_by(comparison, language) %>%
  summarise(
    n_significant = sum(is.finite(q_perm) & q_perm <= alpha),
    prop_significant = mean(is.finite(q_perm) & q_perm <= alpha),
    median_absolute_d = safe_median(abs(cohens_d)),
    q95_absolute_d = safe_quantile(abs(cohens_d), 0.95),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

# 3. Equal-size resampling stability

This is a diagnostic rather than an additional significance filter. It checks
that upper-bound recovery is not driven by a particular equal-size sample and
that any discoveries in the biomedical--biomedical control are not persistent.

```{r stability}
summarize_stability <- function(directory, comparison) {
  feature_stability <- read_result(
    directory,
    "balanced_stability_feature_summary",
    required = FALSE
  )
  rank_stability <- read_result(
    directory,
    "balanced_stability_rank_summary",
    required = FALSE
  )

  feature_required <- c(
    "language", "feature", "full_q_perm", "iteration_coverage",
    "delta_sign_agreement", "top_k_rate"
  )

  feature_summary <- if (
    nrow(feature_stability) > 0 &&
      all(feature_required %in% names(feature_stability))
  ) {
    feature_stability %>%
      mutate(
        full_significant =
          is.finite(full_q_perm) & full_q_perm <= alpha,
        stable =
          is.finite(iteration_coverage) &
          iteration_coverage >= min_iteration_coverage &
          is.finite(delta_sign_agreement) &
          delta_sign_agreement >= min_direction_agreement &
          is.finite(top_k_rate) &
          top_k_rate >= min_top_k_rate
      ) %>%
      group_by(language) %>%
      summarise(
        n_full_significant = sum(full_significant),
        n_significant_and_stable =
          sum(full_significant & stable),
        prop_significant_stable = safe_ratio(
          n_significant_and_stable,
          n_full_significant
        ),
        .groups = "drop"
      )
  } else {
    tibble(
      language = character(),
      n_full_significant = integer(),
      n_significant_and_stable = integer(),
      prop_significant_stable = double()
    )
  }

  rank_summary <- if (
    nrow(rank_stability) > 0 &&
      all(c("language", "median_spearman_rho") %in%
          names(rank_stability))
  ) {
    rank_stability %>%
      transmute(
        language = as.character(language),
        median_rank_stability = median_spearman_rho
      ) %>%
      distinct(language, .keep_all = TRUE)
  } else {
    tibble(
      language = character(),
      median_rank_stability = double()
    )
  }

  full_join(feature_summary, rank_summary, by = "language") %>%
    mutate(comparison = comparison, .before = 1)
}

stability_summary <- bind_rows(
  summarize_stability(
    upper_dir,
    "upper-bound domain contrast"
  ),
  summarize_stability(
    upper_null_dir,
    "biomedical--biomedical control"
  )
)

stability_summary
```

# 4. Recovery of correlated feature clusters

Cluster recovery provides a compact higher-level check. Each authentic cluster
is compared with its closest upper-bound cluster in the same language using
member-feature Jaccard similarity. The threshold is used for this cluster
matching only; it is unrelated to RF caching.

```{r cluster-recovery}
real_clusters <- read_result(real_dir, "cluster_fps", required = FALSE)
upper_clusters <- read_result(upper_dir, "cluster_fps", required = FALSE)
upper_null_clusters <- read_result(
  upper_null_dir,
  "cluster_fps",
  required = FALSE
)

compare_clusters <- function(language) {
  real_language <- real_clusters %>%
    filter(as.character(.data$language) == .env$language) %>%
    distinct(cluster_id, members, .keep_all = TRUE)
  upper_language <- upper_clusters %>%
    filter(as.character(.data$language) == .env$language) %>%
    distinct(cluster_id, members, .keep_all = TRUE)

  n_real <- nrow(real_language)
  n_upper <- nrow(upper_language)

  if (n_real == 0 || n_upper == 0) {
    return(tibble(
      language = language,
      n_authentic_clusters = n_real,
      n_upper_clusters = n_upper,
      n_recovered = 0L,
      recall = ifelse(n_real > 0, 0, NA_real_),
      precision = ifelse(n_upper > 0, 0, NA_real_),
      f1 = 0,
      mean_best_jaccard = NA_real_
    ))
  }

  pairwise <- expand_grid(
    real_row = seq_len(n_real),
    upper_row = seq_len(n_upper)
  ) %>%
    mutate(
      similarity = map2_dbl(
        real_row,
        upper_row,
        ~ jaccard(
          split_members(real_language$members[[.x]]),
          split_members(upper_language$members[[.y]])
        )
      )
    )

  best_for_real <- pairwise %>%
    group_by(real_row) %>%
    slice_max(similarity, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
    ungroup()
  best_for_upper <- pairwise %>%
    group_by(upper_row) %>%
    slice_max(similarity, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
    ungroup()

  recovered <- sum(
    best_for_real$similarity >= cluster_match_threshold,
    na.rm = TRUE
  )
  upper_matching <- sum(
    best_for_upper$similarity >= cluster_match_threshold,
    na.rm = TRUE
  )
  recall <- recovered / n_real
  precision <- upper_matching / n_upper

  tibble(
    language = language,
    n_authentic_clusters = n_real,
    n_upper_clusters = n_upper,
    n_recovered = recovered,
    recall = recall,
    precision = precision,
    f1 = safe_f1(precision, recall),
    mean_best_jaccard = safe_mean(best_for_real$similarity)
  )
}

cluster_required <- c("language", "cluster_id", "members")
if (
  all(cluster_required %in% names(real_clusters)) &&
    all(cluster_required %in% names(upper_clusters))
) {
  cluster_recovery <- map_dfr(
    sort(unique(as.character(real_clusters$language))),
    compare_clusters
  )
} else {
  cluster_recovery <- tibble(
    language = character(),
    n_authentic_clusters = integer(),
    n_upper_clusters = integer(),
    n_recovered = integer(),
    recall = double(),
    precision = double(),
    f1 = double(),
    mean_best_jaccard = double()
  )
}

null_cluster_summary <- if (
  all(c("language", "cluster_id") %in% names(upper_null_clusters))
) {
  upper_null_clusters %>%
    count(language, name = "n_residual_clusters")
} else {
  tibble()
}

cluster_recovery
null_cluster_summary
```

# 5. Multivariate upper-bound calibration

For the RF analysis, forest repetitions fitted to the same cross-validation
split are first averaged within fold. The empirical margin is then the selected
quantile of the absolute paired upper-bound differences:

$$
\widehat{\delta}_{\mathrm{cal}}
=
Q_{0.95}
\left(
\left|
M_{\mathrm{RF}}^{\mathrm{upper}}
-
M_{\mathrm{RF}}^{\mathrm{real}}
\right|
\right).
$$

This value diagnoses the resolution of the procedure. It does not by itself
make a larger difference substantively acceptable.

```{r rf-margin-calibration}
rf_language_raw <- read_result(
  upper_rf_dir,
  "rf_paired_real_generated_lang_raw"
)

if (!"delta_bal_acc" %in% names(rf_language_raw)) {
  require_columns(
    rf_language_raw,
    c("real_bal_acc", "generated_bal_acc"),
    "paired RF language output"
  )
  rf_language_raw <- rf_language_raw %>%
    mutate(delta_bal_acc = generated_bal_acc - real_bal_acc)
}
require_columns(
  rf_language_raw,
  c(
    "language", "fold", "real_bal_acc",
    "generated_bal_acc", "delta_bal_acc"
  ),
  "paired RF language output"
)

rf_fold_units <- rf_language_raw %>%
  group_by(language, fold) %>%
  summarise(
    real_bal_acc = safe_mean(real_bal_acc),
    upper_bal_acc = safe_mean(generated_bal_acc),
    delta = safe_mean(delta_bal_acc),
    n_forest_fits = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

rf_margin_calibration <- tibble(
  n_fold_units = sum(is.finite(rf_fold_units$delta)),
  mean_delta = safe_mean(rf_fold_units$delta),
  median_absolute_delta = safe_median(abs(rf_fold_units$delta)),
  margin_q90 = safe_quantile(abs(rf_fold_units$delta), 0.90),
  margin_q95 = safe_quantile(abs(rf_fold_units$delta), 0.95),
  maximum_absolute_delta = safe_max(abs(rf_fold_units$delta)),
  prespecified_margin = rf_prespecified_margin
) %>%
  mutate(
    selected_margin = if (
      rf_calibration_probability == 0.95
    ) margin_q95 else safe_quantile(
      abs(rf_fold_units$delta),
      rf_calibration_probability
    ),
    prespecified_margin_covers_upper_variation =
      selected_margin <= prespecified_margin
  )

rf_margin <- rf_margin_calibration$selected_margin[[1]]
rf_margin_calibration
```

```{r rf-language-diagnostic}
rf_language_summary <- rf_fold_units %>%
  group_by(language) %>%
  summarise(
    n_folds = sum(is.finite(delta)),
    mean_real_bal_acc = safe_mean(real_bal_acc),
    mean_upper_bal_acc = safe_mean(upper_bal_acc),
    delta = safe_mean(delta),
    delta_lo = safe_quantile(delta, 0.025),
    delta_hi = safe_quantile(delta, 0.975),
    retention = ifelse(
      mean_real_bal_acc > rf_chance,
      (mean_upper_bal_acc - rf_chance) /
        (mean_real_bal_acc - rf_chance),
      NA_real_
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Calibrate on all other languages before evaluating each held-out language.
rf_loo_margins <- map_dfr(
  sort(unique(rf_fold_units$language)),
  function(held_out_language) {
    calibration_delta <- rf_fold_units %>%
      filter(language != held_out_language) %>%
      pull(delta)

    tibble(
      language = held_out_language,
      equivalence_margin = safe_quantile(
        abs(calibration_delta),
        rf_calibration_probability
      )
    )
  }
)

rf_language_diagnostic <- rf_language_summary %>%
  left_join(rf_loo_margins, by = "language") %>%
  mutate(
    interval_status = case_when(
      mean_real_bal_acc <= rf_chance ~
        "baseline not established",
      delta_lo >= -equivalence_margin &
        delta_hi <= equivalence_margin ~
        "equivalent",
      delta_hi < -equivalence_margin ~
        "attenuated",
      delta_lo > equivalence_margin ~
        "exaggerated",
      TRUE ~
        "equivalence not established"
    )
  )

rf_language_diagnostic
```

A margin estimated and evaluated on the same observations will tend to look
successful. The leave-one-language-out diagnostic above is therefore the more
informative check of whether the calibrated resolution generalizes across
languages.

```{r rf-four-layer-overview}
normalize_rf_summary <- function(x, layer) {
  required <- c(
    "mean_real_bal_acc", "mean_generated_bal_acc",
    "mean_delta_bal_acc", "delta_lo", "delta_hi"
  )
  require_columns(x, required, paste0(layer, " RF summary"))

  unit <- if ("language" %in% names(x)) {
    as.character(x$language)
  } else if ("heldout_language" %in% names(x)) {
    as.character(x$heldout_language)
  } else if (
    all(c("source_language", "target_language") %in% names(x))
  ) {
    paste(x$source_language, x$target_language, sep = " -> ")
  } else {
    rep("pooled", nrow(x))
  }

  tibble(
    layer = layer,
    unit = unit,
    mean_real_bal_acc = x$mean_real_bal_acc,
    mean_upper_bal_acc = x$mean_generated_bal_acc,
    delta = x$mean_delta_bal_acc,
    delta_lo = x$delta_lo,
    delta_hi = x$delta_hi
  )
}

rf_layer_spec <- tribble(
  ~layer, ~file,
  "within-language", "rf_paired_real_generated_lang",
  "pooled", "rf_paired_real_generated_agnostic",
  "language-agnostic transfer", "rf_paired_real_generated_lolo",
  "directed transfer", "rf_paired_real_generated_transfer"
)

rf_layer_results <- map2_dfr(
  rf_layer_spec$file,
  rf_layer_spec$layer,
  ~ normalize_rf_summary(
    read_result(upper_rf_dir, .x),
    .y
  )
) %>%
  mutate(
    interval_status = case_when(
      mean_real_bal_acc <= rf_chance ~
        "baseline not established",
      delta_lo >= -rf_margin & delta_hi <= rf_margin ~
        "within calibrated margin",
      delta_hi < -rf_margin ~
        "attenuated",
      delta_lo > rf_margin ~
        "exaggerated",
      TRUE ~
        "inconclusive"
    )
  )

rf_layer_overview <- rf_layer_results %>%
  group_by(layer) %>%
  summarise(
    n_units = n(),
    median_delta = safe_median(delta),
    q95_absolute_delta = safe_quantile(abs(delta), 0.95),
    n_within_margin =
      sum(interval_status == "within calibrated margin"),
    prop_within_margin =
      mean(interval_status == "within calibrated margin"),
    n_attenuated = sum(interval_status == "attenuated"),
    n_exaggerated = sum(interval_status == "exaggerated"),
    n_inconclusive = sum(interval_status == "inconclusive"),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

rf_layer_overview
```

```{r rf-calibration-figure}
rf_calibration_plot <- ggplot(
  rf_language_diagnostic %>%
    mutate(
      language = factor(
        language,
        levels = rev(sort(unique(as.character(language))))
      )
    ),
  aes(x = delta, y = language, colour = interval_status)
) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "grey55", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = c(-rf_margin, rf_margin),
    colour = "#B22222",
    linetype = "dashed",
    linewidth = 0.6
  ) +
  geom_segment(
    aes(x = delta_lo, xend = delta_hi, yend = language),
    linewidth = 0.8
  ) +
  geom_point(size = 2.5) +
  labs(
    x = expression(Delta[RF] == BA[upper] - BA[real]),
    y = NULL,
    colour = NULL,
    title = "Upper-bound RF calibration",
    subtitle = paste0(
      "Global empirical margin: ±",
      sprintf("%.3f", rf_margin),
      "; status uses leave-one-language-out margins"
    )
  ) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )
```

# Paper-facing summary

The main paper needs one compact table and one calibration figure. Detailed
feature lists, stability classifications, and effect-profile plots are better
placed in the appendix.

```{r paper-summary}
paper_summary <- tibble(
  n_languages = nrow(feature_recovery),
  median_feature_recall = safe_median(feature_recovery$recall),
  median_feature_precision = safe_median(feature_recovery$precision),
  median_feature_f1 = safe_median(feature_recovery$f1),
  median_direction_agreement =
    safe_median(feature_recovery$direction_agreement),
  median_effect_profile_rho =
    safe_median(feature_recovery$rho_signed_cohens_d),
  median_rank_profile_rho =
    safe_median(feature_recovery$rho_borda),
  total_null_significant = sum(null_summary$n_significant),
  median_null_significant_share =
    safe_median(null_summary$prop_significant),
  median_null_absolute_d =
    safe_median(null_summary$median_absolute_d),
  median_cluster_f1 = if (nrow(cluster_recovery) > 0) {
    safe_median(cluster_recovery$f1)
  } else {
    NA_real_
  },
  rf_calibrated_margin = rf_margin,
  rf_prespecified_margin = rf_prespecified_margin,
  rf_heldout_languages_equivalent = sum(
    rf_language_diagnostic$interval_status == "equivalent"
  ),
  rf_heldout_languages_total = nrow(rf_language_diagnostic)
)

paper_summary
```

```{r paper-calibration-table}
calibration_by_language <- feature_recovery %>%
  select(
    language,
    feature_recall = recall,
    feature_precision = precision,
    feature_f1 = f1,
    direction_agreement,
    effect_rho = rho_signed_cohens_d,
    rank_rho = rho_borda
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    null_summary %>%
      select(
        language,
        null_significant = n_significant,
        null_significant_share = prop_significant,
        null_median_absolute_d = median_absolute_d
      ),
    by = "language"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    cluster_recovery %>%
      select(language, cluster_f1 = f1),
    by = "language"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    rf_language_diagnostic %>%
      select(
        language,
        rf_real_bal_acc = mean_real_bal_acc,
        rf_upper_bal_acc = mean_upper_bal_acc,
        rf_delta = delta,
        rf_interval_status = interval_status
      ),
    by = "language"
  ) %>%
  arrange(language)

knitr::kable(
  calibration_by_language,
  digits = 3,
  caption = paste(
    "Upper-bound recovery of the authentic domain contrast and residual",
    "divergence in the biomedical--biomedical control."
  )
)
```

```{r calibration-figure}
calibration_plot_data <- bind_rows(
  feature_recovery %>%
    transmute(
      language,
      diagnostic = "Feature recovery (F1)",
      value = f1
    ),
  cluster_recovery %>%
    transmute(
      language,
      diagnostic = "Cluster recovery (F1)",
      value = f1
    ),
  null_summary %>%
    transmute(
      language,
      diagnostic = "Residual significant share",
      value = prop_significant
    )
) %>%
  mutate(
    diagnostic = factor(
      diagnostic,
      levels = c(
        "Feature recovery (F1)",
        "Cluster recovery (F1)",
        "Residual significant share"
      )
    ),
    language = factor(
      language,
      levels = rev(sort(unique(as.character(language))))
    )
  )

calibration_plot <- ggplot(
  calibration_plot_data,
  aes(x = value, y = language)
) +
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = 0,
    linewidth = 0.4,
    colour = "grey70"
  ) +
  geom_point(size = 2.4, colour = "#2C6E9B") +
  facet_wrap(~ diagnostic, nrow = 1) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 1)) +
  labs(
    x = "Proportion",
    y = NULL,
    title = "Upper-bound calibration by language",
    caption = paste(
      "Higher recovery is desirable in the first two panels;",
      "lower residual divergence is desirable in the third."
    )
  ) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold")
  )

calibration_plot
```

# Interpretation

The upper bound supports the calibration if it combines high recovery,
directional and effect-profile agreement in the general--biomedical comparison
with few, small, and preferably unstable discoveries in the
biomedical--biomedical comparison. The RF difference should likewise remain
small and generalize under leave-one-language-out calibration. A weak result on
the first check indicates limited reproducibility of the authentic domain
profile; a weak result on the second indicates sensitivity to ordinary
authentic-sample variation. If the empirical RF variation exceeds the
substantively prespecified margin, the conclusion is limited measurement
resolution at that tolerance—not automatic permission to enlarge the
acceptable margin.
